lines.text: Этот суп действительно очень вкусный и горячий.
lines.trans: This soup is really very tasty and hot.

lines.text: Костя, скажи честно, что с тобой случилось?
lines.trans: Kostya, tell honestly, what happened with you?

lines.text: Всё нормально, я просто вытираю эту рюмку.
lines.trans: Everything is fine, I am simply wiping this glass.

lines.text: Ты моешь её уже целых полчаса.
lines.trans: You have been washing it for a whole half hour already.

lines.text: У Насти за столом сидит важный критик.
lines.trans: An important critic is sitting at Nastya's table.

lines.text: Этот наглый мужчина грубо пристаёт к ней.
lines.trans: This insolent man is rudely hitting on her.

lines.text: Я боюсь сделать что-нибудь плохое для ресторана.
lines.trans: I am afraid of doing something bad for the restaurant.

lines.text: Понимаешь, проблема совсем не в этом критике.
lines.trans: You see, the problem is not at all in this critic.

lines.text: Главный вопрос здесь в том, кто ты.
lines.trans: The main question here is in who you are.

lines.text: Передай мне соль, пожалуйста, юный друг.
lines.trans: Pass me the salt, please, young friend.

words.gloss: to pass on, to hand over

lines.text: Дворник он или критик — это совсем неважно.
lines.trans: Whether he is a janitor or a critic—that is completely unimportant.

words.gloss: it does not matter, never mind, poorly

lines.text: Позволяешь ты обижать свою девушку или нет?
lines.trans: Do you allow someone to insult your girlfriend or not?

words.gloss: to hurt, to offend, to bully

lines.text: Жизнь твоя, и только ты принимаешь решение!
lines.trans: The life is yours, and only you make the decision!

words.gloss: to receive, to see (visitors); to take

examples.trans: We have nobody to fear here.
I grew up in a communal flat.
The bread rings are very tasty.

meanings.note: neuter главное, used as a noun

examples.trans: The main thing is, don't worry.

meanings.en: hot (to the touch, of food/drink, not weather)

examples.trans: Careful, the cup is very hot.
In the morning the janitor works in the courtyard.

examples.text: Девушки, как я, у тебя не будет!
examples.trans: You'll never have a girl like me!

examples.text: Настроение у меня действительно очень хорошее.
examples.trans: My mood really is very good.
This is indeed an important question.
We could open a salon for you.
This is Vanya, my childhood friend.
I was born and grew up here.
There's someone here to see you.
The restaurant critic praised the bartender.

meanings.note: adult male; declines like a feminine -а noun

examples.text: У мужчины бывает не только жена.
examples.trans: A man can have more than just a wife.
This man is waiting for you.

examples.text: Юля, встала и пошла мыть посуду!
examples.trans: Yulia, get up and go wash the dishes!

meanings.note: showing a lack of respect in a rude or aggressive manner

examples.trans: That was a very insolent act.

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates

неважно.gloss: it does not matter, never mind, poorly

meanings.en: it does not matter, never mind

examples.trans: That completely does not matter right now.
Never mind, let us forget about it.

обижать.gloss: to hurt, to offend, to bully

meanings.en: to hurt, to mistreat, to offend
other forms: его (gen/acc), ему (dat), им (instr), нём (prep)

examples.trans: I love our town very much.

передать.gloss: to pass on, to hand over

meanings.en: to pass on, to hand over, to give

examples.trans: Please pass on my regards to your mum.

examples.text: Позволяешь ты обижать свою девушку или нет?
examples.trans: Do you allow someone to insult your girlfriend or not?
The sauce was ordered half an hour ago.

meanings.note: понимаешь? = you know? do you understand?

examples.trans: I want to go to the sea, you know?

принимать.gloss: to receive, to see (visitors); to take

examples.trans: The mayor isn't seeing anyone today.
The doctor sees patients in the morning.

meanings.en: to pester, to bother, to harass (+ к + dat.)

examples.text: Не приставай ко мне с вопросами!
Слушай, Нина, это же тот самый ресторан!
examples.trans: Listen, Nina, this is that very restaurant!

examples.text: Мы рады видеть вас в нашем ресторане.
examples.trans: We are glad to see you in our restaurant.
I am forced to cancel my decision.

examples.text: Только у меня маленьких рюмок нет.
examples.trans: Only I don't have any small shot glasses.
Two shot glasses stood on the table.

meanings.note: + instrumental; со before some consonant clusters: со всеми
refers back to the subject: 'он держит своё слово' = he keeps his word

examples.trans: Why are you sitting in the corner?

examples.text: Я совсем не это хочу сказать.
examples.trans: That's not what I mean at all.
Onion, salt, pepper — and that's all.
We will sit together in a friendly way at the table.

examples.text: Я бы на твоём месте подумал.
examples.trans: If I were you, I'd think about it.

meanings.en: other forms: тебя (gen/acc), тебе (dat), тобой (instr), тебе (prep)

meanings.note: уже четыре года = for four years now

examples.text: Я уже четыре года работаю мэром.
examples.trans: I've been mayor for four years now.

examples.text: Я не могу гулять здесь целый день.
examples.trans: I can't walk around here all day.
We waited for a whole hour.
Do you want me to tell you honestly?

meanings.note: any thing at all, not a particular one
points at something: это моё = that's mine

meanings.en: other forms: этого, этому, это, этим, этом

examples.trans: I'm sick of this communal flat.

meanings.en: other forms: меня (gen/acc), мне (dat), мной (instr), мне (prep)
